|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Force Push & •Podracer Collision]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' ([[Force Push & •Podracer Collision (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 6 October 2023: “USED: If you just verified opponent's Reserve Deck, search that Reserve Deck and place one Interrupt (except Houjix) found there out of play. LOST: Once per game, exchange two cards from hand with any one card from Force Pile; reshuffle. Immune to Too Close For Comfort.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Force Push & •Podracer Collision]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Force Push & •Podracer Collision]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Force Push & •Podracer Collision”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
